note: pilot truths are public by design; never to be reused as an exam

gaps_L_by_truth.note: dL = L(first) - L(second), pooled over the primary cells; positive = the second is better; se_truths = sd over truths of the per-truth mean / sqrt(n_truths)

acceptance.note: rows 'family@n|K reference|cells'; sigma = (L(null) - L(C)) / (L(K) - L(C)), null = the better of D@n and P0; rho = (L(P0) - L(S@n)) / (L(P0) - L(C)); SE and 5-95% range from the bootstrap clustered by truth; L per cell (mean over the cells used); 'anchor<t>' = only the items whose history ends at tick t (largest budget)

theory_T.note: T = the replicator-mutator law for s_b and linear relaxation for N with constants fitted to the first n Lab episodes (vxnet.fit_law); it never runs level 0

cchg.note: reached = (V_change - Ve) / (V_change - Vu), Ve = mean squared error of the predictive mean; se = bootstrap over truths; rows = horizons, columns = (N, s_b)

per_theta_b1.note: b1 fitted per design point from its own episodes (noisy), then regressed on theta

law_design.note: d s_b over h ticks = (b1_0 + sum_i b1_i u_i) s (1 - s) + (b2_0 + sum_i b2_i u_i) (1 - 2 s); u in box units [-1, 1]; design episodes carry the public program mix; states from the given tick on

identification.note: contraction = posterior sd / prior sd per parameter (mean over truths); L1 = from level-1 summaries, L2 = from (N, s_b) only; in90 = share of (truth, parameter) pairs inside the central 90% interval
